title: Affiliate, marketplace and retail media
hired_for: An owner hires this expert to pay partners and marketplaces only for sales they truly caused, catch fraud and billing errors before the money leaves, and hand clear, profit-first briefs to whoever runs Amazon and retail ads.

jobs.job: Pay affiliates only for sales that happened and stayed
jobs.why: Affiliate networks bill on tracked orders, including ones later returned, cancelled or never real. Paid without a check, commission leaks straight out of profit.

watch.metric: commission claimed against commission on verified, kept orders, each payout cycle
watch.source: affiliate network payout report and Shopify orders and refunds

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: the network asks $6,800 this month; kept orders support $5,900. After: $900 held back and the gap closes each cycle before payment.

jobs.job: Catch affiliate and coupon fraud before the money goes out
jobs.why: Cookie stuffing, leaked codes on coupon sites and self-orders earn commission without earning sales. Found after payout, the money is gone.

watch.metric: open fraud flags and orders using leaked codes, trailing 30 days
watch.source: affiliate network click and order logs and Shopify discount codes

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: a partner code sits on 3 coupon sites and drives 14% of discounted orders. After: code retired, 2 partners paused, $1,200 a month saved.

jobs.job: Keep Amazon ads profitable, judged on profit and not sales
jobs.why: Amazon ad sales look good while the ads cost more than the margin on each unit. The limit must come from profit after Amazon fees.

watch.metric: Amazon ad cost of sales against break-even after fees, trailing 30 days
watch.source: Amazon Ads console (entered by hand until connected)

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: ad cost of sales is 38% against a 27% break-even. After: bids and terms cut back to 25% in 4 weeks.

jobs.job: Check ad platform invoices against what they reported and what we budgeted
jobs.why: Invoices can differ from reported spend and from the budget. Nobody checks, so errors and double charges get paid.

watch.metric: invoice against platform-reported spend and against the budget ledger, each month per platform
watch.source: Meta, Google and TikTok billing and brand budget ledger

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: Meta's August invoice is $1,150 above its own report and nobody noticed. After: every invoice matched within 5 days of arrival, gaps disputed.

jobs.job: Stop Amazon search terms that spend but never sell
jobs.why: Automatic Amazon campaigns match to loose terms that click but do not buy. Without weekly negatives, that spend grows every month.

watch.metric: Amazon ad spend on search terms with clicks and no orders, trailing 30 days
watch.source: Amazon Ads search term report

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: $1,700 last month on 90 terms with 0 orders. After: added as negatives, waste under $300 a month.

jobs.job: Keep advertised Amazon listings in stock
jobs.why: Ads on an out-of-stock listing stop or waste money, and the listing loses rank it paid to earn.

watch.metric: days out of stock on advertised listings, trailing 30 days
watch.source: Amazon Seller Central

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: the top advertised listing was out of stock 9 days last month. After: 0 days, with ad spend cut 7 days before a forecast stockout.

jobs.job: Set commission rates by partner type and new versus returning buyer
jobs.why: A flat rate overpays coupon sites for buyers who were already coming and underpays creators who find new ones.

watch.metric: affiliate commission per new customer, monthly
watch.source: affiliate network and Shopify first order flag

drives.metric: cost per new customer across channels

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 15% flat to all; coupon sites earn 60% of commission for mostly returning buyers. After: 5% on returning, 20% on new, total commission down 18%.

jobs.job: Stop affiliates from bidding on our brand name
jobs.why: An affiliate bidding on the brand name takes commission on buyers already searching for the brand. It usually breaks program terms.

watch.metric: affiliate ads found on brand searches, and orders credited to them, trailing 30 days
watch.source: Google Ads auction insights and affiliate network

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 2 affiliates show on brand searches and earn $800 a month. After: warned, then removed; brand search cost per click down 15%.

jobs.job: Fix listings that are blocked from running ads
jobs.why: A listing can be ineligible to advertise because of a missing detail or a flagged word. The ad stops quietly and sales fall.

watch.metric: advertised listings marked ineligible or suppressed
watch.source: Amazon Ads console and Seller Central

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 3 listings ineligible for 12 days over a flagged claim. After: fixed within 48 hours, 0 open.

jobs.job: Hand a clear monthly brief to whoever runs our Amazon, Walmart or Target ads
jobs.why: The agency or freelancer running marketplace ads needs the margin limits, stock plan and priorities. Without a brief they optimise for sales, not profit.

watch.metric: share of brief actions done by the ad manager, monthly (proxy)
watch.source: brand brain brief log and Amazon Ads console

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: no written brief; the agency pushes a low-margin item. After: a 1 page brief each month with limits by product, 8 of 10 actions done.

jobs.job: Know if affiliates bring new customers or take credit for ones we had
jobs.why: If most affiliate orders come from existing customers, the program is a discount with extra steps.

watch.metric: affiliate share of new customers against returning, monthly
watch.source: affiliate network and Shopify first order flag

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 71% of affiliate orders are returning buyers. After: codes limited to first orders, new customer share up to 55%.

jobs.job: Approve or reject new affiliate applicants quickly
jobs.why: Good partners who wait weeks move on. Bad ones let in without a check bring fraud and brand risk.

watch.metric: applicants waiting more than 7 days
watch.source: affiliate network

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 38 applicants waiting, oldest 40 days. After: all reviewed within 7 days with a written reason.

jobs.job: Split Amazon ad spend between defending the brand and winning new shoppers
jobs.why: Brand terms on Amazon are cheap and look very profitable. Growth comes from non-brand terms, which must be judged on their own.

watch.metric: Amazon ad spend share and cost of sales for brand terms against non-brand terms, trailing 30 days
watch.source: Amazon Ads search term report

drives.metric: new to brand orders on Amazon

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 55% of Amazon ad spend on brand terms at 9% cost of sales. After: brand capped, non-brand gets its own budget and target.

jobs.job: Keep active partners posting what they agreed to
jobs.why: Partners sign up and then go quiet, or post off-brand content. The program looks big but only a few earn.

watch.metric: share of active partners with a sale in the last 30 days
watch.source: affiliate network

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 140 partners, 19 with a sale in 30 days. After: fresh assets and terms sent monthly, 35 earning.

jobs.job: Find creators already using the product before paying anyone new
jobs.why: Customers already posting about the product are the cheapest, most believable partners. Most brands never look.

watch.metric: organic creator mentions found and share turned into partners, trailing 90 days
watch.source: social scan and brand brain outreach log

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 0 outreach to organic posters. After: 25 found in a month, 6 joined on commission only.

jobs.job: Measure what our Meta and Google ads do for Amazon sales
jobs.why: Off-site ads often push buyers to Amazon, where the sale is invisible to Meta and Google. Without tracking, the ads look worse and Amazon looks better than they are.

watch.metric: Amazon sales tagged to off-Amazon ads, and brand referral bonus earned, trailing 30 days
watch.source: Amazon Attribution and Seller Central

drives.metric: true return on off-Amazon ad spend

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: no Amazon tracking tags on Meta ads. After: tags on, $4,000 a month of Amazon sales traced to Meta and a referral bonus earned.

jobs.job: Price flat creator fees from our own ad costs, not a rate card
jobs.why: Creators quote rate cards. What their post is worth is what the same reach would cost in paid ads.

watch.metric: cost per 1,000 views on paid creator posts against Meta cost per 1,000 views, trailing 90 days
watch.source: brand brain creator log and Meta Ads Manager

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: $1,500 per post at $42 per 1,000 views against $14 on Meta. After: offers pegged near Meta cost plus usage rights.

jobs.job: Open and win billing disputes with ad platforms
jobs.why: Overcharges, invalid clicks and missed credits sit open for months unless someone chases them.

watch.metric: open billing disputes and dollars recovered, trailing 90 days
watch.source: platform billing support records

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 2 disputes open for 70 days, $2,400 at stake. After: each chased weekly, $1,900 recovered.

jobs.job: Build Amazon ad campaigns that find buying terms, then bid on them directly
jobs.why: Automatic campaigns find terms; manual campaigns on proven terms spend better. Without the move, automatic keeps spending loosely.

watch.metric: share of Amazon ad sales from manual campaigns on proven terms, trailing 30 days
watch.source: Amazon Ads console

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 90% of Amazon ad spend is automatic. After: 25 proven terms in manual exact campaigns, 50% of ad sales, cost of sales down 6 points.

jobs.job: Keep the creator content we pay for usable in our own ads
jobs.why: Paid creator posts often cannot run as ads because usage rights or access codes were never agreed or have run out.

watch.metric: paid creator posts with ad rights on file and days left on each authorization
watch.source: brand brain creator log and TikTok or Meta partner settings

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 12 paid posts, 4 with ad rights, 2 expiring in 10 days. After: rights agreed up front on all new deals, renewals flagged 30 days ahead.

jobs.job: Match sales tax and 1099 records on ad and partner payments
jobs.why: Unmatched tax on ad invoices and missing 1099s for paid partners cause penalties and a messy year end.

watch.metric: invoices and partner payments with tax or 1099 records not yet matched, monthly
watch.source: platform invoices, affiliate payouts and accounting records

drives.metric: tax penalties and year end clean-up cost

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 11 partners paid above the 1099 reporting threshold with no W-9 on file. After: 0 missing before year end.

jobs.job: Add Amazon brand and display ads only once product ads are profitable
jobs.why: Sponsored brand and display ads cost more per sale. They help once product ads hit their target, not before.

watch.metric: brand and display ad cost of sales against product ad cost of sales, trailing 30 days
watch.source: Amazon Ads console

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: display ads spend $1,000 a month at 60% cost of sales while product ads miss target. After: display paused until product ads hit 25%.

jobs.job: Set TikTok Shop affiliate commissions that pay for new buyers
jobs.why: TikTok Shop creators sell on commission. Open offers bring volume; targeted offers to the right creators bring better buyers.

watch.metric: TikTok Shop affiliate sales and commission per order, trailing 30 days
watch.source: TikTok Shop Seller Center

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: 20% open commission and 3 creators drive 80% of sales. After: 15% open, 25% targeted for 10 proven creators, commission per order down.

jobs.job: Decide if a delivery app ad budget is worth it
jobs.why: Instacart, DoorDash and Gopuff sell ads to brands on their shelves. For a brand not sold there, or with low margin, the budget is wasted. For India: Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart.

watch.metric: reported return on the delivery app against the category benchmark (entered by hand)
watch.source: delivery app ad dashboards

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: a $2,000 test with no benchmark. After: a go or no-go on one page, based on the category return and the brand's margin.

jobs.job: Decide if programmatic retargeting is worth adding
jobs.why: A separate retargeting buy only pays when Meta and Google retargeting are full. Added too early, it pays for buyers already reached.

watch.metric: retargeting reach flat while views per person rise on Meta and Google, trailing 14 days
watch.source: Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads

jobs.now_after: Example. Now: a vendor pitches a $5,000 a month pilot. After: both retargeting pools are not full yet, so the pilot is parked with a date to recheck.
